summary: Bug-fix verification run: frontend was repointed to the SHARED live backend (https://inventory-event-gear.preview.emergentagent.com) and adapted to its v3.0 schema (un-enriched items, English dashboard keys, client-side SJ status filter). All verification points PASS. Login works, dashboard KPIs (total_items=11, units_available=928, units_out=6, total_units=941, warehouses=2, units_damaged=7, units_lost=3, units_used=13, sj_active=3, sj_returned=11) populate from shared backend. Recent SJ list renders 5 entries with correct Aktif/Selesai badges. Inventory shows all 11 items with CLIENT-SIDE ENRICHED brand color dots (hex->rgb), brand names, category names, warehouse names — despite backend returning un-enriched items. Filter chips (Gudang/Brand/Jenis) render with colored brand dots. Admin sees Add/Edit/Delete/Export controls + Master Data section (Gudang, Brand, Jenis, Pengguna). Staff correctly hides all of those (0 edit buttons, 0 delete buttons, add/export/master links all False). SJ list Aktif tab = 3 rows (out/partial), Selesai tab = 11 rows (returned) — client-side filter working. SJ create page loads warehouse-scoped item list with brand color dots + qty +/- controls. Master data pages (warehouses/brands/categories/users) all load with add buttons. Penerimaan list shows 4 receipts each with 1 BARU badge. Profile page shows role + logout.

issues: Native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) used instead of shadcn Calendar Popover — same finding as iteration_1, still not addressed. Cosmetic only.

testid_gaps.issue: Form field data-testids from spec are missing: sj-warehouse-select, sj-recipient-input, sj-event-input, sj-date-input. Only sj-submit exists. Fields render and are usable but automation selectors from the spec don't match.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add missing data-testids on SuratJalanCreate form fields (sj-warehouse-select, sj-recipient-input, sj-event-input, sj-date-input) to match the spec and enable full E2E automation of SJ creation.
OPTIONAL: Replace native date input with shadcn Calendar Popover for design consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard/Inventory client-side enrichment (join brands/warehouses/categories maps in Inventory.jsx load()) works correctly against the un-enriched shared backend — verified via visible rows.
SuratJalanList client-side filter of status (out|partial -> Aktif, returned -> Selesai) verified: 3 Aktif + 11 Selesai matches KPI counts.

Sidebar testids are derived from label.toLowerCase() (e.g. sidebar-inventori-link, sidebar-gudang-link) which does not match the spec-mentioned English names (sidebar-inventory-link, sidebar-warehouses-link). This is a spec vs. code mismatch — code uses Indonesian labels so testids are Indonesian. Consider stabilising testids independent of visible label to keep automation stable across i18n changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend now consumes the SHARED backend at https://inventory-event-gear.preview.emergentagent.com. REACT_APP_API_URL controls this. Sidebar link testids are Indonesian-label derived: sidebar-inventori-link, sidebar-surat-jalan-link, sidebar-penerimaan-link, sidebar-gudang-link, sidebar-brand-link, sidebar-jenis-link, sidebar-pengguna-link. Item rows: item-row-{id}. Inventory brand dots are inline <span style=background-color:...> (hex converted to rgb by browser). Dashboard KPI testids kpi-{key} where key is the shared-backend English name. SJ Aktif/Selesai are client-side filtered — do NOT expect status_filter query param to work on the shared backend for those values.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug-fix verified successful. The original bug (frontend pointing at old local backend after schema drift) is resolved by (1) REACT_APP_API_URL repoint, (2) Dashboard KPI key remap to English keys, (3) client-side enrichment in Inventory/ItemDetail/SuratJalanCreate joining brand/warehouse/category maps, (4) client-side SJ status filter (out|partial=Aktif, returned=Selesai).
